_note: Settings › Legal › Licenses (q(129); SET-LICENSES, Figma page 14 1254:88796, 不知火舞 280 4c8d286a). Groups in order, rows in order: title, license (the line under it), credit (a data credit's attribution, word for word, above its license 6 apart; Map data only), page (q(133) v3: a page the row opens instead of a text; map_data is Map data), text (the full text the row's › opens: a file in the package, or "engine" for Godot's own license and its third-party notices). Software lists what the package depends on; Map data is added by hand (it is not in any dependency list). License texts are the publishers' own files, unchanged (cc-by-4.0.txt: creativecommons.org legalcode.txt; odbl-1.0.txt: opendatacommons.org odbl-10.txt; unicode-license-v3.txt: cldr-json 48.2.0's LICENSE (q(210) ④, the country names); mapbox-maps-android-LICENSE.md: the packed SDK version's LICENSE.md with the licenses it bundles, from tools/p0/update_mapbox_license.sh — 李白); the page joins their hard-wrapped lines.
